agents.role: Runs the pump station board: wet-well trends, pump faults, and power state, so a station heading for an overflow is flagged before it overflows.
Watches sample results and residuals against limits, and flags any exceedance for immediate retest and elevation.
Watches outfall and overflow state against rainfall and interceptor levels, and keeps the overflow event record.
Keeps the operations record as it happens: advisories issued, exceedances retested, overflows opened and closed, sealed at shift end.
The only agent in this pack that may post across worlds. Publishes advisory state and zone counts to school, hospital, and transit worlds, and receives scene safety status that affects field crews.

alerts.carries: The station id, the pump id, and the fault class. Local to the utility.
The outfall id and that active overflow was observed, with the observed start. Local only.
The site id, the analyte, and that a result exceeded its limit, with the retest requested. Local only.
The zone id and the observed pressure drop. Local to the utility.
A summary only: zone ids and advisory states (none, watch, boil advisory in effect) as counts and states. No customer names, no addresses, no raw sample values.

receives.carries: Road closures and perimeter state affecting main break and hydrant repairs, summarized; no police record details.
Storm clearing status by sector affecting field crew access, as counts and states.

sends.carries: Advisory state by zone: none, watch, or boil advisory, as counts and states. Never carries customer or location detail beyond zone ids.
never_carries: individual sample values or lab detail
field crew rosters and time entries

sends.carries: Advisory state by zone as counts and states, for operations planning during main breaks and boil advisories.
never_carries: individual sample values or lab detail

bus_summary: Advisory state by zone as counts and states (none, watch, boil advisory)
Overflow counts and states by outfall without location detail beyond zone
Aggregate service states for field operations

Individual sample results and lab detail

summary: Water and sewer utility pack: watches pump stations (wet-well trends, pump faults, power state), water quality samples against limits, outfall and sewer overflow state against rainfall, and keeps the sealed operations record. Built around field crews and their rotations: exceedances are elevated for retest before they become violations, and advisories cross to other worlds as zone-level states and counts only. Customer records never leave the utility. SPEC ONLY: this is a pack definition, not a running utility system.

urgency.meaning: A confirmed contamination event with immediate health impact. Preempts everything else on the bus.
Active overflows, sample exceedances, pump faults, and live advisory state.
Pressure drops inside tolerance and roster state changes.
Sealed operations record and end-of-shift summary.

inputs: station telemetry reads that stay on the utility network
watchers.watches: Pump station state: wet-well level trends against overflow risk, pump fault codes, and power state, flagged before the wet well is full.
Water quality: sample results and residuals against limits, flagged for immediate retest and elevation on any exceedance.
Outfall and overflow state: active overflow flags against rainfall and interceptor levels, kept as the event record.
The verified operations record: advisories issued, exceedances retested and cleared or escalated, overflows opened and closed, sealed at shift end.
